Tutors filter the session-history table to find past sessions faster.

replies.text:
To get this into a hi-fi prototype, I need a Figma frame link with a `node-id` to trigger the build workflow, plus clarity on a few open screen states before staging.

I checked `uno-blueprint`, the repo components (`design-system/src/components/index.js`), and `prototypes/` just now, so this is current. The blueprint has no `live` cells for a tutor session-history view, though the design system provides [`Table`](https://github.com/BilLogic/plus-uno/tree/main/design-system/src/components/_internal/Table), [`SelectMultiple`](https://github.com/BilLogic/plus-uno/tree/main/design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs), and [`DateAndTimePicker`](https://github.com/BilLogic/plus-uno/tree/main/design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs).

### Open gaps to settle

1. **Figma frame URL (required for bot scaffold):** Bot-staged builds run through GitHub Actions via `prototype_scaffold`, which needs a Figma frame URL containing a `node-id`. If you don't have a Figma frame and want to build directly in code, that routes to the in-IDE agent instead.
2. **Filter controls & logic:**
   - Are subject and student single-select or multi-select dropdowns?
   - Is date a single date picker, a date-range picker, or pre-set pills (e.g., *Last 7 days*, *This month*)?
   - Confirming logic: do the filters combine with `AND` (matching all selected criteria)?
3. **States & edge cases:**
   - **Empty state:** What copy and visual should render when no sessions match the active filters?
   - **Reset:** Is there an explicit "Clear filters" action, or do tutors uncheck each one?
4. **Target destination:** Should this scaffold a fresh prototype under `prototypes/session-history/`, or live within an existing prototype like `prototypes/live-app/`?
